Wikipedia (Taronga Western Plains Zoo: 'about 5 km from the city') and Wikivoyage ('5 km taxi or bus ride') give the road distance. Visitors travel by road, so use 5 km in copy, say 'by road'. Keep 3 km only as the internal span calculation.

caves_distance.finding: placement.json's 33 km is wrong. Great-circle from centre to Wikipedia caves coordinates (-32.62083, 148.93806) is 51.4 km, so '51 km' holds only as a straight line. Wikipedia (Wellington NSW) puts the town 49 km SE of Dubbo and the caves are 8 km (Wikipedia) / about 9 km (operator) south of Wellington on the Mitchell Highway, so the drive is roughly 58 km and no source gives drive time. 'South-east' is supported (Wellington is 'SE of Dubbo', caves are further south-east). Copy should say 'about 50 km south-east' and never 'off the Mitchell Highway' for the 51 km figure (that 9 km is Wellington to the caves). defaultZoomSpanKm 70 stays valid (75% = 52.5 km > 51.4).

items.text: A Central West city with an open-range zoo, a 19th-century gaol and limestone caves within a day trip.
items.note: Zoo and gaol supported; caves as a day trip per Wikivoyage; 'within a day trip' means the caves, fine. 'Largest in Orana' (variant 2) also supported by Wikipedia.

items.text: Dubbo is a city of 43,516 people (2021) at the junction of the Newell, Mitchell and Golden highways, about 400 km by road from Sydney, and the largest population centre in the Orana region. Most visitors come for Taronga Western Plains Zoo, which opened in 1977 on 300 ha and uses concealed moats rather than fences. In town, Old Dubbo Gaol, a gaol from 1859 to 1966, is now a museum. Wellington Caves, about 50 km south-east, are the usual day trip.
items.note: Pop 43,516 (June 2021), three highways, 400 km road, Orana: Wikipedia. Zoo 28 Feb 1977, 300 ha, concealed moats: Wikipedia. Gaol: proclaimed a gaol 12 July 1859 (operator /discover), closed 1966 (Wikipedia; Wikivoyage 'official gaol from 1859 to 1966'). Fix: '51 km' to 'about 50 km' (straight line, not a drive distance); 'usual day trip' is Wikivoyage's 'good day trip' - ok. Variant 2: 'at the airport' for RFDS ok (21 Judy Jakins Dr, beside Dubbo Regional Airport per Wikivoyage geo -32.216, 148.571); 'half-day trip' is unsourced - cut. Variant 3: 'west of Sydney' - Wikipedia says north-west, Wikivoyage 'west'; 400 km road ok; 'a second day' unsourced. Do not use variant 3 wording 'in the centre' loosely: gaol is on Macquarie Street in town, ok.

reasons: See elephants, giraffes and black rhinos in an open-range zoo with no fences
Tour a former gaol that held prisoners until 1966
Take a guided tour through Wellington Caves, limestone karst about 50 km from town
items.note: Elephants, giraffes, black rhinos: Wikivoyage and Wikipedia (Asian elephants, South-central black rhino, giraffe). 'No fences': Wikipedia 'walls and fences replaced by concealed moats'. Gaol: Wikipedia 1966 closure. Caves: tours of three cave sites (operator); 'guided' is supported (Wikipedia 'guided tours'). Fix only '51 km' to 'about 50 km'. Variant 1: 'diprotodon and giant kangaroo bones found in 1830' supported (Wikipedia: George Ranken, two years after 1828); 'cycle or drive round' fails ('drive' unsupported, bikes and carts are) - use variant 2. Variant 3 'Walk the cells' supported but reason 1 (bike hire) is not shown by the giraffe photo.

tips: No car needed to reach Dubbo: an XPT train runs daily from Sydney, usually arriving 2-3 PM, and the zoo is about 5 km from town by road, with a taxi, bus or the Tracker Riley Cycleway to get there.
Book zoo tickets online, where an adult is from $51.30 against $57.00 at the gate. The zoo is open every day of the year, with the Zoo Circuit running 9:00 AM-4:00 PM.
Summer highs often pass 40 C, so visit the zoo early or outside summer; Wellington Caves are open 9:00 AM-4:15 PM daily and tours are booked through the caves' website.
items.note: Tip 1: XPT daily 2-3 PM (Wikivoyage); 'few places practical without a car' (Wikivoyage); 5 km taxi/bus, cycleway from centre to zoo (Wikivoyage). Fix: zoo is 5 km by road (not 3). Tip 2: ticket-prices and visitor-information pages. Tip 3 fix: 'must be booked' and 'allow a half day with the drive' are not sourced (site says 'BOOK TOURS HERE' and Wikivoyage 'good day trip'), so reworded. 'Summer highs often pass 40 C' Wikipedia ('often peaking above 40 C'). Variant 2 tip 3 'January's mean max 33.6 C' ok but 'in winter mornings can drop below zero' ok (Wikipedia subzero). Variant 3 tip 3 is wrong as written: 'Wellington Caves are 51 km off the Mitchell Highway' (cut; the caves are 9 km south of Wellington on the highway). Variant 3 tip 2 'Savannah Visitor Plaza from 8:30 AM' ok.
